brief:
Palestine has become the first country to host a UNESCO chair through the American University, according to Maan Wire. The chair was established at the institution as part of UNESCO's global initiative to advance knowledge and research across member states.

The UNESCO chair program operates in universities worldwide to promote research, training, and networking in specialized fields. The American University's selection reflects the institution's standing in Palestinian higher education and its capacity to meet UNESCO's academic standards for the designation.
title: Palestine hosts first UNESCO chair through American University.
